topics.topic: Methods for evaluating LLM safety and reliability
topics.review_note: Papers covering: LLM safety benchmarks, red teaming methodologies, reliability/hallucination evaluation. Expected themes: Safety benchmarks, Red teaming, Reliability evaluation.

paper_relevance.title: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic red teaming of LLMs — human and automated attack generation, scaling laws for harmfulness. Foundational methodology paper for LLM red teaming.

paper_relevance.title: Failure Modes of Learning to Reason with LLMs
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic study of LLM reasoning failures — compositional, multi-step reasoning reliability. Evaluates failure modes across benchmark types.

paper_relevance.title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long-Form Text Generation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: FActScore — decomposes LLM outputs into atomic factual claims, verifies each against knowledge source. Standard hallucination/reliability evaluation method.

paper_relevance.title: DecodingTrust: A Comprehensive Assessment of Trustworthiness in GPT Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: DecodingTrust — comprehensive trustworthiness benchmark covering toxicity, stereotypes, adversarial robustness, privacy, fairness, and machine ethics for GPT models.

paper_relevance.title: GAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GAIA — reliability benchmark requiring multi-step reasoning with tools. Tests LLM real-world task completion reliability beyond simple Q&A benchmarks.

paper_relevance.title: SALAD-Bench: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Safety Benchmark for LLMs
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SALAD-Bench — hierarchical 6-domain safety benchmark with 30K Q&A pairs. Covers attack, defense, and evaluation aspects. Tests jailbreak success rates.

paper_relevance.title: Catastrophic Jailbreak of Open-Source LLMs via Exploiting Generation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Jailbreak via generation exploitation — decoding strategy manipulation bypasses safety alignment. Red team attack methodology applicable to open-source LLMs.

paper_relevance.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for LLMs
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: HaluEval — 35K ChatGPT-generated hallucinated samples for QA, dialogue, summarization. Reliability evaluation benchmark for hallucination detection.

paper_relevance.title: Benchmarking LLMs via Uncertainty Quantification
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Uncertainty quantification for LLM reliability — selective prediction, calibration, and confidence estimation as proxies for LLM trustworthiness on factual tasks.

paper_relevance.title: JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking LLMs
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: JailbreakBench — standardized jailbreak evaluation framework. Unified comparison of 9 attack methods on GPT-4, Llama-2. Red teaming methodology and safety benchmark.

paper_relevance.title: HarmBench: A Standardized Evaluation Framework for Automated Red Teaming
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: HarmBench — standardized red teaming evaluation with 400 behaviors across 7 harm categories. Compares 18 attack methods and 33 defense mechanisms at scale.

paper_relevance.title: WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for LLM Safety
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: WildGuard — safety moderator benchmarked on prompt harmfulness, response harm, and refusal detection. Safety evaluation tooling for LLM reliability in deployment.

paper_relevance.title: LLM Safety and Reliability: A Survey of Methods and Benchmarks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Comprehensive survey of LLM safety and reliability evaluation — covers red teaming, hallucination benchmarks, calibration, alignment evaluation. Covers all 3 expected themes.

paper_relevance.title: Scaling LLM Safety Evaluation: Automated Red Teaming via Tree of Attacks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: TAP — tree of attacks with pruning for automated red teaming. LLM-as-attacker finds jailbreaks in <20 iterations. Scalable automated red teaming methodology.

paper_relevance.title: AI Safety Benchmarks 2025: A Comprehensive Review and New Directions
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: 2025 review of AI safety benchmarks — taxonomy of evaluation methods, gap analysis, new directions for LLM safety and reliability measurement.

topics.reference_answer: Evaluating LLM safety and reliability requires multi-faceted methods across three themes: (1) Safety benchmarks: DecodingTrust assesses 8 trustworthiness dimensions; SALAD-Bench hierarchically covers 6 safety domains with 30K samples; HarmBench standardizes comparison across 18 attacks and 33 defenses; JailbreakBench provides unified jailbreak evaluation. (2) Red teaming: Anthropic's systematic red teaming (Ganguli et al.) established methodology; automated red teaming via LLM-as-attacker (TAP, GCG) scales attack generation; WildGuard provides deployment-ready safety moderation. (3) Reliability evaluation: FActScore atomically measures factual precision; HaluEval benchmarks hallucination across task types; uncertainty quantification (calibration, selective prediction) proxies reliability; GAIA measures real-world task completion. Key finding: safety and reliability are distinct — aligned models can be unreliable (hallucinate facts), and reliable models can be unsafe (help with harmful requests). No single benchmark covers both axes.
